revised_claim_text: Industry baseline cargo theft recovery rate is ~26% (ATRI 2025: ~74% of stolen cargo never recovered). Specialized telematics programs report markedly higher rates — Overhaul claims 96% recovery for its FTL clients [vendor self-report]. [ASSUMED-N] The specific 73%/<20% split by alert-timing bucket appears only in vendor-adjacent trade blogs (FleetRabbit, GetSafeAndSound); no CargoNet, NICB, ATRI, FBI, or academic primary source publishes recovery rate broken out by notification-delay bucket — to validate: obtain CargoNet member-portal annual report.
footnote_for_artifact: ATRI cargo theft research, October 2025 (truckingresearch.org/2025/10/new-atri-research-confirms-the-high-costs-of-cargo-theft-to-industry — NEEDS-ATTENDED-FETCH); Verisk CargoNet 2024 Annual Supply Chain Risk Report (non-member version via TAPA); TT Club / BSI Cargo Theft Report 2024 (April 2024). The 73%/<20% timing-bucket split remains industry lore without confirmed primary attribution.
